Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind  issue a writ of Mandamus, forbearing the respondents from vacating the  petitioner or demolishing the dwellings situated in plots No.52, 54,
 Ex-Serviceman Colony, Mullai Nagar, Meenambalpuram, B.B.Kulam, Madurai  without paying adequate compensation and deciding about the proper  rehabilitation and resettlements under the Right to Fair Compensation an  Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2  For Petitioner : Mr.RM.Arun Swaminathan
For Respondents : Mr.S.Shaji Bino  Special Government Pleader  ORDER (Order of the Court was made by M.S.RAMESH,J.)

This Writ Petition has been filed for Mandamus,
forbearing the respondents from vacating the petitioner or demolishing the dwellings situated in plots No.52, 54, Ex-Serviceman Colony, Mullai Nagar, Meenambalpuram, B.B.Kulam, Madurai without paying adequate compensation and deciding about the proper rehabilitation and resettlements under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents.

3. The only apprehension of the petitioner is that the respondents herein would resort to evict the petitioner, without following the due procedure contemplated under the Tamil Nadu Land Encroachment Act.

4. The learned Special Government Pleader submits that in case there is any encroachment in the subject lands, the same shall be removed, after following the due procedures provided under the Tamil Nadu Land Encroachment Act.
In the light of such a submission, no further orders are required to be passed in this Writ Petition.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
